The '''Clan Sharratt enclave''' was an enclave of Mandalorian [[Clan Sharratt]] located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Sharratt enclave appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
